packageRules.description: Minor, patch and digest updates merge by themselves once CI passes
Major updates wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
Multipaz and Ktor move together; the wallet carries workarounds for Multipaz
Toolchain: Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform and the Android Gradle plugin
Credential Manager and DC API need a device check, CI does not cover them
xml-apis 2.0.2 is an old relocation artifact, not a newer release
sha2 stays on 0.10: the native crates share digest 0.10 with k256, p256 and rsa, and zkpdf-prover needs the compress feature that 0.11 removed
rand stays on 0.8 in diw-zk-ffi: taceo-oprf-core (0.6.x) takes rand 0.8 generators, and rand 0.10 has no thread_rng
Rust crates wait for review: native/Cargo.lock was not refreshed with the sha2 0.11 and snow 0.10 bumps, and both reached main while the locked native builds failed
bincode 3.0.0 is an empty release that only fails to compile (the project stopped); zktls stays on 1.x until it moves to another format
LiteRT moves with Multipaz FaceNet, which is built against LiteRT 1.x; a 2.x runtime under it needs a device check of face matching

Git-pinned proving stacks move only on purpose: the Noir revision goes with the nargo and bb versions in native/circuits/VERSIONS and the compiled circuits, TLSNotary is an alpha protocol, Spartan2 backs the OpenAC age circuit keys
